Definition: of Hebrew origin (H4111); Maleleel (i.e. Mahalalel), an antediluvian:--Maleleel.
BiblicalUsage: Maleleel is the Greek form of Mahalalel, the antediluvian patriarch, named once in the New Testament, in Luke 3:37, in the genealogy of Jesus, where he stands as the son of Cainan and the father of Jared. His name is Mahalalel in the Hebrew, and he is counted among the patriarchs who lived before the flood.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Maleleel's one verse ties the old world to the new: the patriarch who lived eight hundred and ninety-five years is an ancestor of Jesus.
